player_prompt.intro:
Tiririt di Tower of Hanoi s {num_disks} ifadden.
Yessefk ad teskecmeḍ ifadden seg borj A ɣer borj C.
Akken ad teskecmeḍ afad, aru borj n tazwara d borj n targit (amseḍru, '[A C]').
Ldiɣ-d akken ur nezmer ara ad neskecm afad meqqer fell-as afad meẓẓiy.
Di krayat, azen-d yiwen usekcem.

invalid_move.invalid_tower: Telliḍ-d d taẓeyt n lqanun neɣ tansa ur nelli ara.
invalid_move.empty_tower: Tεerḍeḍ ad tgeḍ asalu seg yiwet n tewrirt ixuṣen.
invalid_move.same_tower: Teɛreḍ ad tgeḍ asalu ɣer yiwet n lberj.
invalid_move.larger_on_smaller: Teɛreḍ ad ternuḍ asikel meqqren ɣef yiwen usikel amecṭuḥ.

outcome.win: Ayyuz-ik! Tfeḍ tamsirt n uẓru n Hanoi.
outcome.turn_limit: Tessaweḍ-d uswir n uḥric. Teḍra deg {pct}% seg yideskiyen ɣef Tawrirt C.
